extraction_notes: The supplied three-page datasheet contains no transfer-characteristics, output-characteristics, or capacitance-versus-VDS figures, so no usable curves were extracted.
P-channel signed voltage and current entries are represented as positive magnitudes in the numeric fields for fitting, while original signed bias conditions are preserved in the condition text.

The threshold row publishes MIN = -0.4 V and MAX = -1.1 V with no typical value; the magnitude fields retain those source-column meanings, so threshold_min = 0.4 V, threshold_typ = null, and threshold_max = 1.1 V.

The datasheet publishes no gate charge, body-diode reverse-recovery time, thermal resistance in K/W, or IDSS typical value beyond the maximum IDSS row; these are not represented by fields in this schema.
omission_reason: No usable transfer, output, or capacitance curves are present in the supplied three-page PDF; only tabulated electrical characteristics are available.
